scope: Fifteen IMA September 2026 critical-element mineral species (burtite, cabalzarite, cabriite, coutinhoite, falcondoite, ferrotitanowodginite, ferrowodginite, fetiasite, gatelite-(Ce), khomyakovite, kimrobinsonite, kimuraite-(Y), liandratite, manganokukisvumite, margaritasite) with 100% primary-source visual inspection across all IMA-cited references and five bounded laboratory thermal/hydrothermal mechanisms. Seven additional investigated candidates are explicitly deferred.

selection.reason: Missing IMA:1980-078 calcium hexahydroxostannate CaSn(OH)6 from the El Hamman tin-rich garnetite skarn, central Morocco; complete CM 19 (1981) 397-401 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 33 inspected.

Missing IMA:1997-012 calcium-magnesium-aluminum tsumcorite-group arsenate CaMg2(AsO4)2(H2O)2 from Falotta Mn mine, Switzerland; complete AM 85 (2000) 1307-1314 primary PDF inspected, including N2 TGA 640-700 C dehydration.

Missing IMA:1981-057 palladium-copper-tin intermetallic mineral Pd2CuSn from the Oktyabr'sk Cu-Ni sulfide deposit, Noril'sk, Russia; complete CM 21 (1983) 481-487 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 33 inspected.

Missing IMA:2003-025 thorium-barium uranyl silicate hydrate Th_xBa_(1-2x)(UO2)2Si5O13.3H2O from the Corrego do Urucum pegmatite, Galileia, Minas Gerais, Brazil; complete AM 89 (2004) 721-724 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 50 inspected.

Missing IMA:1976-018 hydrous nickel sepiolite-group silicate Ni4Si6O15(OH)2(H2O)2.4H2O from the Loma Peguera garnierite laterite deposit, Bonao, Dominican Republic; complete CM 14 (1976) 407-409 primary PDF inspected, including 4-step DTA/TGA dehydration to orthopyroxene and 1 M MgCl2 cation-exchange leaching.

Missing IMA:1998-028 (Fe2+,Ti)-dominant wodginite-group tantalum oxide Fe2+TiTa2O8 from the San Elias and La Viquita granitic pegmatites, Sierra de la Estanzuela, San Luis, Argentina; complete AM 84 (1999) 773-777 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 72 inspected.

Missing IMA:1984-006 Fe2+-dominant tin-tantalum wodginite-group oxide Fe2+Sn4+Ta2O8 from the Sukula granitic pegmatite, Tammela, southwestern Finland; complete CM 30 (1992) 633-638 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 72 inspected.

Missing IMA:1991-019 iron-titanium pyroarsenite mineral (Fe2+,Fe3+,Ti)3O2(As3+2O5) from Pizzo Cervandone, Italy, and Gorb, Binntal, Switzerland; complete AM 79 (1994) 996-1002 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 73 inspected.

Missing IMA:2001-050 Ce-dominant epidote-tornebohmite ET polysomatic nesosubsilicate (Ca,Ce)4(Al,Mg,Fe)4(Si2O7)(SiO4)3(O,F,OH)3 from the Trimouns talc deposit, Luzenac, Ariege, France; complete AM 88 (2003) 223-228 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 80 inspected.

Missing IMA:1998-042 tungsten-strontium-zirconium eudialyte-group cyclosilicate Na12Sr3Ca6Fe3Zr3W(Si25O73)(O,OH,H2O)3(Cl,OH)2 from Poudrette quarry, Mont Saint-Hilaire, Quebec, Canada; complete CM 37 (1999) 893-899 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 112 inspected.

Missing IMA:1983-023 tantalum hydroxide-carbonate mineral Ta(OH)3(O,CO3) from weathered pegmatite near Mt. Holland, Western Australia; complete CM 23 (1985) 573-576 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 113 inspected.

Missing IMA:1984-073 hydrated calcium-yttrium carbonate CaY2(CO3)4.6H2O from Kirigo alkali basalt fissures, Hizen-cho, Saga Prefecture, Japan; complete AM 71 (1986) 1028-1033 primary PDF inspected, including DTA-TGA and heated-sample FTIR two-stage dehydration and decarbonation.

Missing IMA:1975-039 hexavalent uranium niobate-tantalate U6+Nb2O8 from the Antsakoa I granitic pegmatite, Berere, Madagascar; complete AM 63 (1978) 941-946 primary PDF inspected, including thermal recrystallization of metamict liandratite at 650-1000 C to trigonal P-31m U6+(Nb,Ta)2O8.

Missing IMA:2002-029 Mn-dominant titanium-silicate mineral Na6MnTi4Si8O28.4H2O from Poudrette quarry, Mont Saint-Hilaire, Quebec, Canada; complete CM 42 (2004) 781-785 primary PDF and IMA September 2026 Master List p. 135 inspected.

Missing IMA:1980-093 Cs-dominant hydrated uranyl vanadate Cs2(UO2)2(VO4)2.H2O from the Margaritas deposit, Sierra Pena Blanca, Chihuahua, Mexico; complete AM 67 (1982) 1273-1289 primary PDF inspected, including hydrothermal CsCl ion-exchange conversion of carnotite to margaritasite at 200 C.

deferred_candidates.reason: Co-described with khomyakovite in Can. Mineral. 37 (1999), 893-899 (CM37_893.pdf, inspected in full); deferred beyond the bounded 15-record Round 119 batch for subsequent curation.
Co-described with liandratite in Am. Mineral. 63 (1978), 941-946 (AM63_941.pdf, inspected in full); deferred beyond the bounded 15-record Round 119 batch for subsequent curation.

Supplemental Kirigo data in Am. Mineral. 71 (1986), 1028-1033 (AM71_1028.pdf) inspected in full, but original 1971 Perttunen species description (Bull. Geol. Soc. Finland 43:67-72) is outside the open RRUFF archive; deferred to preserve 100% primary-source inspection.

Discredited/reclassified pyrochlore-supergroup member co-occurring with kimrobinsonite in CM 23 (1985), 573-576; deferred because current IMA-CNMNC nomenclature maps to hydrokenomicrolite/hydroxycalciomicrolite.

Carried forward from Round 118: original 1978 description (CM16_561.pdf) inspected, but second IMA reference (Am. Mineral. 72 (1987), 365-374) and 1998 J. Phys. Chem. B thermal study are not in the open archive.
Carried forward from Round 118: 1987 crystal-structure paper (AM72_1230.pdf) inspected, but original 1986 Mineral. Mag. 50:125-129 description is paywalled.
Carried forward from Round 118: original 1982 description (CM20_231.pdf) inspected, but second IMA reference (Mineral. Mag. 89 (2025), 511) is not locally available in full text.

deduplication.note: No pre-existing owner record in data/records/ matched any of the 15 selected mineral species prior to Round 119 creation.
